decisions.reason: Criminal impersonation case: suspect posed as NSA TAO head and Supreme Court chief justice to intimidate officials and quash legal proceedings. No real security incident, vulnerability, or breach. NSA involvement is purely alleged pretense by the defendant.

decisions.story_title: CISA Red Team Findings: Government Sector Fails, Water Sector Detects Simulated Attack
decisions.reason: CISA published rare public red-team results. In the government target, red teamers gained initial access via phishing, escalated privileges, and moved laterally to sensitive business systems and cloud resources undetected. In the water sector target, defenders quickly detected and quarantined the compromise. Substantive readiness assessment at a time of heightened concern over water sector targeting.
